summary.tldr: Lowers the Criminal Code criminal interest rate from 60% to the Bank of Canada’s overnight rate plus 20%.
what_it_does: Replaces the Criminal Code definition of “criminal rate” so it applies when the effective annual interest rate is above the Bank of Canada’s overnight rate plus 20%.
Adds a definition of “Bank of Canada’s overnight rate” as the rate on the day the credit agreement is made or renewed.
Sets the bill to come into force 60 days after royal assent.
summary.background: The bill amends section 347(2) of the Criminal Code, which defines the criminal rate of interest.
